name: Order Item Details Column for WooCommerce
author: youxnet

sections.description:
Order Item Details Column for WooCommerce is a lightweight yet powerful backend enhancement plugin designed to improve WooCommerce order management efficiency.

Once activated, the plugin adds a new “Order Item Details” column to the WooCommerce orders list, allowing administrators to view essential order product information without opening each order individually.

This plugin is especially useful for cross-border ecommerce stores, B2B stores, wholesale sellers and operational teams that handle large volumes of orders daily.

Free vs Pro Version

Order Item Details Column for WooCommerce is available in both Free and Pro versions.

The free version focuses on displaying essential order product and cost information directly in the WooCommerce orders list, helping store managers quickly understand order contents at a glance.

The Pro version is designed for professional sellers, B2B stores and high-volume operations, offering more advanced product data, customization options and operational efficiency enhancements.

Features

✔ Adds Order Item Details column in WooCommerce Orders table
✔ Displays product names
✔ Displays product quantity
✔ Automatically reads product Capacity attribute (Capacities)
✔ Shows line subtotal
✔ Shows shipping fee
✔ Shows formatted order total
✔ Clean structured display
✔ Zero configuration — works instantly after activation
✔ Lightweight — no performance worries
✔ Works on all admin screen sizes

Why We Built This Plugin

As a platform deeply involved in cross-border ecommerce practice and technical service, CBSHS discovered a common problem among WooCommerce sellers:
The default WooCommerce backend requires repeatedly entering each order detail page just to check product information and cost details — which is extremely inefficient, especially for stores handling frequent or bulk orders.

This plugin was developed to solve that real operation pain point — enabling sellers and teams to instantly view full order product structure and fee information directly on the order list page, significantly improving work efficiency.

Why Upgrade to Pro?

If your store handles large volumes of orders or requires deeper product-level visibility, the Pro version can significantly improve operational efficiency.

With the Pro version, you can:

• View complete product metadata (SKU, attributes, custom fields) directly from the order list
• Reduce repetitive order detail page visits
• Speed up fulfillment, packing and auditing workflows
• Improve accuracy for B2B and wholesale order processing
• Customize how order item data is displayed

The Pro version is ideal for growing WooCommerce stores that rely on speed, clarity and operational precision.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • Fully compatible with WordPress 6.8+
  • WooCommerce latest version
  • Fully supports WooCommerce HPOS (High Performance Order Storage)
  • Supports legacy order storage
  • PHP 7.2+
  • Compatible with PHP 8+

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins page
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Orders
  4. You will now see a new column named Order Item Details

No configuration required.
sections.faq:
Does it support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and legacy order storage.

Does it affect website performance?

No. It only displays backend data and does not add database burden.

Do I need to configure anything?

No configuration needed. Simply install and activate.

Is there a Pro version available?

Yes. A Pro version is available with advanced features such as SKU display, full attribute visibility, custom meta support and additional customization options.

Will the free version stop working if I don’t upgrade?

No. The free version will continue to work normally and receive maintenance updates. Upgrading to Pro is optional.

Is the Pro version compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Both Free and Pro versions fully support WooCommerce HPOS and legacy order storage.
